chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you both deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the verse 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as addressing both Jinn and humans, or alternatively men and women, highlighting the dual nature of divine blessings. The repetition underscores the concept of *tawhid* in attributes, reminding believers that all favors stem from the Merciful One, yet are often met with ingratitude (*kufr al-ni'mah*). This rhetorical device serves as a spiritual mirror, urging self-reflection on one's recognition of Allah's continuous grace.
